text: dsh-weixin 是把个人微信接入 DSH 的消息通道插件：首次启动通过二维码登录，之后轮询接收聊天消息，并为每个聊天对象维护一个常驻 Agent 和独立会话。它支持文字及图片、语音、视频和文件输入，也能将 Agent 回复的文字或本地文件发回微信。适合希望通过个人微信与 DSH 默认模型持续对话的用户；需要配置微信账号并启动对应的 DSH profile。

dsh-weixin connects personal WeChat chats to DSH. After QR login, it polls for messages and maintains a resident Agent per chat. It handles text and media, and sends text replies or marked local files back. Chat with the host default model through WeChat using a configured DSH profile.
想用个人微信和 DSH 默认模型持续聊天。
让 DSH 在微信收到消息后自动交给 Agent 回复。
我想给每个微信聊天对象保留各自的对话上下文。
能不能扫码登录微信，然后让它一直收取新消息？
希望在微信里发图片或文件，让本机的 Agent 处理。
怎么把 Agent 生成的本地文件通过微信发给对方？
I want to chat with my DSH assistant through personal WeChat.
Can incoming WeChat messages be handled by a separate persistent agent per chat?
dsh-weixin 的功能「微信二维码登录与消息接收」：首次启动时生成并保存二维码链接供手机微信扫码；登录后通过 getUpdates 长轮询收取消息，并为每个聊天对象创建常驻 Agent。
dsh-weixin 的功能「按聊天对象持续对话」：收到消息后按发送者标识复用对应 Agent，排队处理同一聊天的请求，并把回复发送回该微信对象。
dsh-weixin 的功能「微信媒体收发」：收到图片、视频、语音或文件时下载到 rootDir 下的 media 目录供 Agent 读取；回复中的 [[wxfile:绝对路径]] 标记会触发本地文件发送。
dsh-weixin 使用微信二维码登录，并在本机 rootDir 下保存状态、凭证和收到的媒体文件；README 的“仅文字”限制与当前代码已实现的媒体收发不一致。

dsh-weixin README · dsh-weixin：> Part of the **DSH ecosystem** — channel plugins built on the [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://npm.im/@deepseek-ai/dsh) plugin architecture.

Personal **WeChat** channel plugin for the [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://npm.im/@deepseek-ai/dsh) — turn `dsh` into a WeChat bot with **one long-lived Agent per chat peer** (true rolling memory, flushed to disk).

dsh-weixin README · How it works：This plugin talks **directly** to WeChat's official **iLink Bot API** (the same protocol behind Tencent's `@tencent-weixin/openclaw-weixin` gateway plugin). It uses that Tencent-maintained package as a plain protocol library — **no OpenClaw gateway, no forwarding, no cloud relay** — and replaces the gateway glue with DSH Agents:

dsh-weixin README · How it works：```
your WeChat ⇄ Tencent iLink API ⇄ this plugin (getUpdates long-poll)
                                        └→ one resident DSH Agent per peer
                                           replies via sendMessage
```

dsh-weixin README · How it works：- **QR login** on first boot: the QR link is printed to the log and written to `<rootDir>/login-qr.txt` (render it or open it in WeChat). The flow auto-refreshes expired QRs and retries.
- **Credentials** are stored under `<rootDir>/state/openclaw-weixin/accounts/<bot-id>.json` (0600), isolated from any OpenClaw installation via `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`.
- **Inbound**: every text message wakes the peer's Agent (created lazily, memory spans the process lifetime; sessions persist to the DSH session store).
- **Model**: whatever the host's default model selection is (`agent-default-model` in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`).
- Resilient: long-poll timeouts and transport errors back off exponentially (5s→120s) and reconnect.

On first boot it prints a QR link — scan it with your phone WeChat, confirm,
and the bridge enters the poll loop. Subsequent boots reuse the saved token.

dsh-weixin README · Configure (optional, via the profile's cordis.patch.yml)：```yaml
- id: weixin-bridge
  config:
    rootDir: ~/.dsh/weixin-channel   # state + workspace root
    accountId: default               # logical account label

dsh-weixin README · Notes & limits：- **One iLink connection per WeChat account globally** — don't run another
  WeChat gateway (OpenClaw, Hermes, hermesclaw…) on the same account while
  this bridge runs, or tokens will conflict (403s / dropped messages).
- Text messages only in v0.1 (the protocol lib also supports images/voice/
  files — media handling is a natural next step).
- Self-sent messages don't reach the bot channel; test from another account.
- Reply latency = model turn time (tens of seconds typical); the iLink side
  has no typing indicator wired up in v0.1.
